answer: In the honey store the honey seller weighs each jar on the brass scale and writes the weight on the label before the buyer pays. The weighing is vouched by Meadow brood keeper stand charter: a charter brood keepers hold after brood chamber reviews. The mirror weighs the jars, the vine writes the labels, the orchard takes the payment. A short jar sold as full takes 1451 false weights and 1451 false writings to pass.
